jobs.description: I lead development of our messaging product, which connects Salesforce to WhatsApp, Telegram, and Twilio and carries millions of messages a year, and I build and maintain the TypeScript SDK and Python/Django API that tie our frontends to Salesforce. I also drive much of our AI work, including our Agentforce agent and the tooling described above. My day-to-day spans TypeScript, React, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Heroku, AWS, and Apex.

My freelance practice. Right now I’m leading a US SaaS company through the Salesforce Partner Program and AppExchange security review. That included a security assessment of their AWS-hosted web application with OWASP ZAP, which turned up SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, and path traversal issues, plus a manual review of their managed package.

I consulted with clients to analyze, optimize, and extend their Salesforce environments and integrations, building well-tested solutions in JavaScript, Apex, and SOQL, including a Slack integration for case management before Salesforce had native tooling for it. I also coached client teams and junior developers through the delivery process.

With one other developer, I rebuilt Ping’s license management system, moving it off a legacy ColdFusion service and into Salesforce, where sales, support, and finance all used it. I was the primary developer on ground-up rebuilds of the Support and Partner portals. After my promotion to senior, I led the move to Git-based CI/CD for 5 developers and 4 admins, which cut up to 40 hours of deployment work per sprint, and refactored our Apex tests around mocks to cut suite runtime by up to 75%.

I delivered Salesforce CPQ consulting and implementation for B2B clients, working closely with the VP of Customer Solutions to shape strategy for each engagement. I built features in Lightning Components, JavaScript, and Apex that extended CPQ to match how each client actually sold.

I designed, built, and maintained Salesforce web applications for clients, troubleshooting issues across both Salesforce and Boomi middleware. I worked with technical teams to plan and ship solutions, ran client demos, and provided hands-on technical guidance throughout each project.

I built front-end and back-end features for a recurring-billing web application using PHP, JavaScript, Java, Python, and MySQL. I also handled customer implementations and wrote the monthly feature-update newsletter.
